title: Basic Questions
description: Learn the essential Hindi question words: what, where, when, how much, and why.

exercises.explanation: These question words unlock thousands of possible questions in Hindi.

exercises.question: How do you ask 'how much does this cost?' in Hindi?
exercises.explanation: 'Yeh kitne ka hai?' = how much does this cost? — kitne = how much, ka = of, hai = is.
'Yeh kahan hai?' = where is this/it? — yeh = this, kahan = where, hai = is.
'Kyun' means why — 'kyun nahin?' = why not? is a very common phrase.
'Tum kab aaye?' = when did you come? — kab = when, aaye = came.

exercises.question: What does 'kya' mean?
exercises.explanation: 'Kya' means what. It is also used at the start of yes/no questions: 'kya tum theek ho?' = are you okay?
'Yeh kitne ka hai?' = how much is this? — yeh (this) + kitne (how much) + ka (of) + hai (is).
'Tumhara naam kya hai?' = what is your name? — combining 'kya' (what) from this lesson with introductions vocab.
exercises.hint: sounds like: tum-haa-raa naam kyaa hai
